environment: LinkeDOM actual HTML + Node VM; controlled Auth, RPC and deferred responses.

checks.name: anonymous page makes no article or access RPC and direct hash remains locked
password reveal toggles without losing value; failed login clears password
another account cannot load any title, original or analysis
authorized login can open a direct private article link
stored original is rendered as plain text and private notes stay out of reading page
logout clears original, analysis, titles, links and lists immediately
expired session clears an existing reader without waiting for another request
pending list response cannot restore titles after logout
pending full-text response cannot restore the reader after logout
pending authorization response cannot unlock a signed-out page
missing private migration fails closed before title or original requests
back-forward cache lifecycle clears original and revalidates before restore
SDK stores auth in sessionStorage, discards old persistent key and uses private RPCs
